newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bullion markets closed for kite festival.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bullion markets closed for kite festival.

text.p: Bombay's gold and silver trade was shut on Tuesday for the local kite festival, a traditional Hindu festival, dealers said. Trading will resume on Wednesday.
On Monday, gold and silver prices saw profit-taking after opening higher in early trade.
"Bullion prices in the world market during the second half of last week remained firm but firmness eased today," one dealer said after markets closed on Monday.
